logo.title: Workspace logo
logo.help: Shown in the workspace overview, management and guest menus without their own logo.

preparationHelp: During cocktail preparation, different actions can be performed. Here you can adjust and create them. Note that deleting only works once an action is no longer used.
groupsHelp: These can be created with methods; here you can set the display label
unitsHelp: Here you can adjust all units available when preparing a cocktail.
conversionsHelp: Here you can adjust the default unit conversions.
iceHelp: Here you can adjust ice cube types. Note that deleting removes all references to that ice.
dayStartHelp: Defines when a "day" starts for statistics. Useful for bars whose workday does not start at midnight (e.g. 18:00).
deleteWorkspaceConfirm: Really delete workspace including all ingredients and recipes?
apiKeysHelp: Create API keys to grant external services controlled access.
apiKeysHelpLong: Create API keys to grant external services controlled access to your workspace. Each key can have specific permissions.
apiKeyImportant: Important: This API key is shown only once. Store it securely.

validation.codeMinLength: Code must be longer than 5 characters
validation.expiresInFuture: Expiry date must be in the future

apiKeyImportantSuffix: This API key is shown only once. Store it securely.
permissionSelectAllTip: Select all permissions – grants full access to all endpoints

permissionDesc.MONITOR_UPDATE: Set, change and remove monitor/signage settings
permissionDesc.GUEST_MENUS_READ: Read guest menus (including drafts) and templates
permissionDesc.GUEST_MENUS_CREATE: Create new guest menus and templates
permissionDesc.GUEST_MENUS_UPDATE: Edit guest menu drafts, schedules and templates
permissionDesc.GUEST_MENUS_PUBLISH: Publish/unpublish guest menus and set the public address
permissionDesc.TAGS_READ: Read tag definitions and tag categories
permissionDesc.TAGS_UPDATE: Edit tag definitions and tag categories

timezoneHelp: Together with the day start time, determines the current bar day (active card, “out today”).
primaryContentLanguageHelp: Language in which cocktails, ingredients etc. are maintained.
noAdditionalContentLanguages: No additional content languages added yet.
publicSlugHelp: Guest menus are available at /m/{{slug}}. Leave empty to not assign a public address.
publicSlugInvalid: Only lowercase letters, digits and single dashes (3–64 characters)
publicSlugReserved: This address is reserved because it looks like an internal ID. Please add a dash, for example.
publicSlugTaken: This public address is already used by another workspace.
showGuestMenuExtras: Show cocktails only on the guest menu

general.nameHelp: Shown in the workspace overview, the navigation and exports.
general.regionHelp: Time zone, currency and day start define guest menu prices and which bar day it currently is.
general.deleteHelp: Permanently deletes the workspace including all ingredients, recipes, cards and statistics.

public.slugDescription: Published guest menus are publicly available at this address.
public.guestMenusHelp: Design, schedule and publish guest menus.
public.relatedSettings: Guest menu prices and languages follow:

languages.contentHelp: Content is maintained in the primary language; translations can be added for additional languages (e.g. for guest menus).
languages.centerHelp: Translate cocktails, ingredients, garnishes and glasses into the additional content languages – with progress per language and CSV import/export.
languages.labelsHelp: Display names of preparation methods, preparation groups, units and ice in the app languages. The German label is required.

data.exportHelp: Downloads a complete backup of the workspace (recipes, ingredients, cards, settings, …) as a JSON file.
data.importHelp: Imports a previously exported backup into this workspace.
data.importWarning: The import adds the backup's contents to the existing data; existing entries are not deleted. This may create duplicates.
data.importGuestMenus: Imported guest menus are disabled and unpublished, without access code – check and publish them afterwards.
data.importSkipped: Some entries of the backup were invalid and have not been imported:

users.membersHelp: All members of this workspace and their roles.
users.invitationCodesHelp: New users can join the workspace with an invitation code or link.
